system.description: Rock baboons are larger versions of normal baboons and are more intelligent. They are omnivores but prefer meat. They are not inclined to eat humans, preferring small herd animals when they can catch such beasts. They do not make tools or weapons but will pick up bones or branches to use as clubs. Rock baboons form packs of up to 30 members, each pack led by a dominant male. They are ferocious and have vicious tempers. They do not speak a true language, but use simple screams to communicate warnings and needs. Rock baboons will not go out of their way to attack travelers, but will try to scare intruders out of their hunting grounds.
